rules: Fixed before the run. Costs stay on (fees, 25 bp main / 30 bp xyz stop slip, funding). Flow gates stay off because the venue has no historical aggressor tape. Halves are split at the midpoint of each frame's candle span, and a trade belongs to the half it opened in. Levels still use only bars that had closed by the decision. Improvement requires at least 20 trades, higher expectancy than that frame's reference in both halves, and higher expectancy on at least 4 of 6 coins. A half with fewer than 8 trades is thin and cannot pass. Profitable requires expectancy above zero in both halves on top of that. US hours are 13:30–20:00 UTC. A partial banks half at 1R or 2R and moves the stop to entry; the same bar trading back to entry stops the remainder. A stop on the same bar as the target still wins. Time-none is a 30-day cap so the sample can end the trade. Worst coins dropped: {'best-15m': 'BTC', 'struct-1h': 'xyz:XYZ100', 'daily-1h': 'xyz:SP500'}.
